note: Each control below is set in the unit template today. The denial column is the test that would prove it works on a host. None of these tests has a recorded result in the repository yet, so each one is marked not run. Run the command on a deployed host and record the output under benchmarks or .verify before you claim it.

directives.name: DynamicUser=yes
directives.effect: Service runs as a throwaway user, not root.

directives.name: ProtectSystem=strict, ProtectHome=true
directives.effect: Root filesystem and home directories are read-only to the service.

directives.name: StateDirectory={{.StateDir}}
directives.effect: The only writable place is the service's state directory.

directives.name: CapabilityBoundingSet= (empty), AmbientCapabilities= (empty)
directives.effect: No Linux capabilities, even for root inside the unit.

directives.name: SystemCallFilter=@system-service, ~@privileged @resources @module @reboot @swap @raw-io
directives.effect: Seccomp filter that blocks privileged, module, reboot, and raw I/O calls.

directives.name: RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
directives.effect: No raw, packet, or netlink sockets.

directives.name: ProtectProc=invisible, ProcSubset=pid
directives.effect: The service cannot see other processes in /proc.

directives.name: MemoryDenyWriteExecute=true, LockPersonality=true
directives.effect: No writable-and-executable memory; no personality changes.

directives.name: MemoryMax=1G, CPUQuota=200%
directives.effect: Cgroup limits. Not yet tested under OOM.

directives.name: UMask=0077
directives.effect: New files are private by default.

denials.command: from a shell inside the unit: touch /usr/anode-probe
probe that listens on :80 under the unit
run a setuid helper from the service
grep CapEff /proc/self/status from inside the unit

denials.expect: Score reported; recorded per unit template version
Killed by the cgroup; restarted by Restart=always
